Maya (PM): Heads-up 1 AtlasHealth asked for a private preview with per-route throttles, structured audit logs, and rollback guarantees. Need to scope beta commitments.
Rob (Eng Lead): Per-route throttles (token rate + concurrency) and audit logs are doable if we limit scope. Estimate ~6 weeks for must-haves. Rollback SLA: we can offer manual rollback (runbook) for beta; automated cross-region failover is GA work.
Tess (Design): Atlas expects a simple console control + API examples. I can produce a minimal mock reusing route config in 3 days.
Devon (Customer Success): Atlas wants clear launch criteria and onboarding plan before signing. Also compliance requires sampled outputs under NDA.
Sasha (Research): I can build an eval harness for a 50-prompt set and automated regression checks. Will need Atlass prompt list.
Maya (PM): Proposed split: MUST = throttles (tokens/concurrency), audit logs (structured), eval harness + 50 prompts, launch criteria doc, 2-week onboarding. NICE = console UI, cross-region rollback SLA, managed sampling pipeline.
Rob (Eng Lead): Audit log schema needs fields: timestamp, request_id, route_id, user_id, model, tokens_in/out, decision_flags. Also retention defaults and KMS hook for Private. I'll draft spec.
Tess (Design): UX: default throttle conservative + tooltip. Will include curl/SDK snippets.
Devon (Customer Success): Launch criteria idea: 1) Eval passes (no regressions >5%), 2) Load test: sustained 200 RPS, 300ms P95 on dedicated config, 3) Audit logs include token attribution + metadata, 4) Onboarding plan with daily check-ins week 1.
Maya (PM): For rollback, beta offer: manual rollback within 2 hours (on-call). GA: automated failover.
Rob (Eng Lead): Also include recommended dedicated pool commit and burst config; will add autoscale policy.
Sasha (Research): I'll export sample outputs to secure bucket and tag artifacts for traceability. Need legal greenlight.
Devon (Customer Success): I'll confirm NDA scope and request the priority prompts + compliance contact.
ops-bot: Reminder 1 DP scope negotiation meeting on 2025-07-08 10:00 AM in #product.
Maya (PM): Action items: Rob -> throttle + audit spec by Tue; Tess -> console mock by Thu; Sasha -> eval harness draft by Fri; Devon -> NDA + prompts by Fri. I'll assemble the launch criteria doc and timeline.
Rob (Eng Lead): Starting draft PR in eng-repo; will include reviewers.
Tess (Design): Posting mocks to design board and noting defaults.
Devon (Customer Success): Will loop in Atlas PM after NDA.
Sasha (Research): Will tag eval artifacts for regression tracking.
Maya (PM): Thanks all 1 I'll post the doc link here when ready. :thumbsup:
